sentences.en: I need a pencil. Can I use one of yours?
sentences.zh: 我需要一支铅笔。能用你的其中一支吗？

sentences.en: That sister of yours is always complaining of her husband.
sentences.zh: 你那个姐姐总是抱怨她的丈夫。

sentences.en: The policeman said to the girls, "Is this car yours?"
sentences.zh: 警察对那些女孩说："这辆车是你们的吗？"

senses.zh: 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信，尊函
你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语
